stories.title: MLB trade deadline winners and losers: What we loved -- and don't understand
stories.summary: The 2026 trade deadline has passed. Here's who hit it out of the park -- and who swung and missed.

stories.title: MLB trade grades: Red Sox add Rutschman, Cubs get Holmes from Mets
stories.summary: Our running scorecard for every big move before Monday's deadline.

stories.title: Breslow: Surging Red Sox deserved big trades
stories.summary: The Red Sox acquired three-time All-Star catcher Adley Rutschman in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles, the biggest in a slew of deadline moves for Boston.

stories.title: Tigers' president defends return in Skubal trade
stories.summary: Tigers president Scott Harris dismissed the idea that Detroit should've waited right up until the deadline to trade Tarik Skubal, saying, "That's not how markets for the top players work."

stories.title: Injury-depleted Cubs acquire Holmes from Mets
stories.summary: The Cubs acquired right-hander Clay Holmes and outfielder Tyrone Taylor from the Mets for infielder Jefferson Rojas on Monday.
